s: Sheryl Sandberg (born August 28, 1969, Washington, D.C., U.S.) is an American technology executive who was the chief operating officer (COO) of the social networking company Facebook from 2008 to 2022. Sandberg sat on Facebook’s (now Meta) board of directors starting in 2012 and announced her departure from the board in January 2024.
